_readme: All listing copy. Edit here, then run `npm run listing` (images) or `npm run listing:video`. Rules (checked by test/listingCopy.test.ts): no stars, ratings or reviews; no made-up numbers; ADHD only as "ADHD-friendly" — never "treats", "manages" or "reduces" ADHD; never "behind" or "missed".
